rules.message: Source edit: the convention section of CLAUDE.md and docs/discipline.md are loaded in this session. Rules live there -- not summarized here.
Instruction document: rules + symptoms only, no dated cases, no counts, one rule in one place, section titles not numbers. See docs/workflow.md (Instruction Authoring Policy section) before editing.
Hook config: requires.reads paths and skill names must exist (a typo blocks every file the rule matches). Verify with the commands in .claude/hooks/README.md after editing.

Spec: if it contains code-structure design (types, modules, interfaces, dependencies), run /design-review before committing. Blockers are the user's call; accepted violations go in the spec's intentional-exceptions table.
Board: one-line cards, prerequisites as a '- prereq: `<id>`' line only, commit right after editing. Run bash scripts/board-ready.sh -- stale or broken edges must be zero.
